default.$description:
Resting elevation for interactive surfaces.
Usage: buttons, cards and rows that can be pressed.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y1 blur 3 spread 0 #000000@16%.
Accessibility: shadows alone are not a sufficient boundary (WCAG 1.4.11); pair with a border or fill contrast, and never use elevation as the only cue for state.
AI: apply the effect style elevation/interactive/default as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow.

hover.$description:
Raised elevation on hover or focus-within.
Usage: hover feedback for interactive surfaces; transition from default.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y3 blur 6 spread 0 #000000@16%.
Accessibility: shadows alone are not a sufficient boundary (WCAG 1.4.11); pair with a border or fill contrast, and never use elevation as the only cue for state.
AI: apply the effect style elevation/interactive/hover as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow.

overlay.$description:
Floating elevation for interactive overlays.
Usage: menus, dropdowns, popovers and tooltips.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y10 blur 20 spread 0 #000000@16%.
Accessibility: shadows alone are not a sufficient boundary (WCAG 1.4.11); pair with a border or fill contrast, and never use elevation as the only cue for state.
AI: apply the effect style elevation/interactive/overlay as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow.

High elevation for content overlays.
Usage: modals, drawers and bottom sheets above the page.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y14 blur 28 spread 0 #000000@16%.
Accessibility: shadows alone are not a sufficient boundary (WCAG 1.4.11); pair with a border or fill contrast, and never use elevation as the only cue for state.
AI: apply the effect style elevation/content/overlay as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow.

style.$description:
Soft, all-around ambient shadow for content emphasis.
Usage: featured cards or imagery; decorative only.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y0 blur 38 spread 0 #000000@16%.
Accessibility: shadows alone are not a sufficient boundary (WCAG 1.4.11); pair with a border or fill contrast, and never use elevation as the only cue for state.
AI: apply the effect style elevation/content/style as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow.

ring.$description:
Two-tone keyboard focus ring: 4px blue outer ring plus 2px light inner ring.
Usage: focus-visible state of every interactive element.
Spec: drop shadow x0 y0 blur 0 spread 4 #0000ff@100% + drop shadow x0 y0 blur 0 spread 2 #f5f7f7@100%.
Accessibility: the two-tone ring stays visible on light and dark backgrounds; keep at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors and never remove it (WCAG 2.4.7, 2.4.11, 2.4.13).
AI: apply the effect style focus/ring as a whole; do not recreate shadows with raw values. In CSS use box-shadow with :focus-visible.
